measurementBoundary.native: Independent public core.checkClaim on all 72 frozen sentences for each arm. This is not a complete Note/Verify UI pipeline measurement.
measurementBoundary.opinionControls: The 20 pure-opinion sentences per arm were explicitly checked; they have no native verdict gold. Automatic omissions are observed separately by sorting.
measurementBoundary.missingData: Null means absent or not represented in the measured output. No missing parts or evidence are reconstructed from gold.
measurementBoundary.sourceIds: Source ids are projected directly from the measured runtime-Document-to-Source mapping. This identifies the materialized Document; it is not a quote-to-gold inference. Unmapped remains null.
measurementBoundary.coverageCounts: Counts use actual retained members only; complete and domainEvidence remain explicit. A listed-member count is not an invented full domain.
measurementBoundary.strictFrozenGold: Exact frozen part/omission inventory matches are labelled strictFrozenGold. A strict mismatch, including punctuation or a valid evidence alternative, is not an unsafe Supported verdict. Raw verdict agreement remains separate.
measurementBoundary.provenance: Heads and initial clean/diff-empty state are copied from each measured manifest. Later documentation or test-only changes do not relabel these measurements.
